description: This header file declares functions related to configuring and reading data from an accelerometer sensor, including initialization, configuration, and obtaining acceleration metrics.

methods.name: configureAccelerometerPins
methods.description: Sets up the hardware pins used by the accelerometer.

methods.name: getLongitudinalAcceleration
methods.description: Returns the acceleration value in the longitudinal direction.

methods.name: getTransverseAcceleration
methods.description: Returns the acceleration value in the transverse direction.
